ideas.title: Following the Money in Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the flow of money in Medicaid fraud cases, including kickbacks and other fraudulent activities.
questions: How do Medicaid fraud schemes work?
What are the most common types of Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: I believe that following the money in Medicaid fraud cases could lead to a deeper understanding of the issue and potentially uncover new allegations and investigations.
